answer: To stop fake bots on the ferrous network, each sponsor locks 400 tokens in a refundable stake deposit for every active downstream invitee in its vouch tree and completes a 64 KB task audit every 6 hours. An attacker seeding 150 fake accounts behind a dune relay must freeze 60,000 tokens in sponsor bonds to earn at most 10,000 tokens, losing 100% of the 60,000 token bond when any child fails audit. One honest worker on the voyage hub locks 400 tokens once per 7 days. This fails if deep pools rent stake.
